question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. “Fecilitation”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling is ‘**F****acilitation**’.
 
• ‘Facilitation’ means the process of making something possible or easier.
 
• Example:
 
 
• ​*The company focuses on the **facilitation** of tour and travel services.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'Fecilitation' is incorrectly spelled among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
